details: His second question was with regard to in-flight connectivity. That is very much on our table and is in process. The rules are being framed, as far as the Department of Telecom is concerned. We have already identified the framework now.

records.title: Toll Frauds
details:
Part (d); NHAI is considering the installation of audit cameras at high-value
toll plazas to independently monitor the accurate count and
classification of passing vehicles using Artificial Intelligence (AI).
Additionally, NHAI has invited bids for the implementation of a
FASTag and Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)-based barrier-
free tolling system on a pilot basis at Gharaunda, Choryasi, Nemili, UER-
II and Dwarka Expressway. This system enables user fee collection
exclusively through FASTag. E-notices are proposed for Invalid/Non-
FASTag vehicles, thus eliminating the cash collection from the toll
collection process.
